correctness.rationale: For every pair in a candidate subset, a complete case split across point-point, line-line, incident and nonincident point-line types gives a necessary-and-sufficient incidence predicate. The standalone Python checker independently enumerates all shortest paths by BFS and verifies identical membership outcomes on all 16384 subsets; exact counters and single-vertex extension tests yield the face/facet polynomials. A 7! collineation census plus explicit polarity produces all 336 automorphisms and four fully enumerated facet orbits. Both finite derivation and executable certificate support exactly the stated 14-vertex claim; no infinite extrapolation.

value.rationale: The unique Fano incidence (Heawood) graph is a canonical symmetric cubic girth-six cage with nontrivial mixed point/line geodesics. A complete visible-subset census, the sharp nonpure facet sizes 6 and 7, and four symmetry orbits under all 336 automorphisms constitute a natural exact incidence-geometric classification and a checkable benchmark for ordinary mutual visibility, rather than an arbitrary subset census or only a trivial scalar invariant.
